newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares extend losses, volume shrinks.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares extend losses, volume shrinks.

text.p: Istanbul shares extended losses in continued selling on Wednesday in thin volume, brokers said.
The IMKB-100 closed at 82,215.01, down 1,507.99 points, or 1.8 percent from Tuesday when it lost 1.14 percent after a 1.03 percent rise on Monday to an all-time high close of 84,692.20.
Trade volume further dived to 14.2 trillion lira ($144.7 million) from Tuesday's 16.5 trillion ($168.3 million) and Monday's 21.5 trillion ($219.4 million).

"The market has failed in three (recent) attempts to pierce the 85,000 barrier. A volume of 25 to 30 trillion lira is needed for this. It is now possible for the index to ease to 80,000-81,000 support again this week," said Dilek Akdemir from Yatirim Finansman.

The index had drifted to 81,500 support in a week-long pull back after the first attemt on 85,000 on October 31, following a 29.3 percent rally and ten record closes in a medium-term uptrend from September 13 to October 23.
